finding.behavior: A global exportMode associated all asynchronous server exports with the most recently clicked button. The client discarded the existing response eventId.

browserBaseline.environment: Isolated Chrome with prior reviewed app/client modules and actual Node/WebSocket room. Only the external QA server queues export responses.
browserBaseline.delivery: last response first, then first response

changes: Associate each export kind with its existing eventId; match one response to one pending request. Allow different kinds to overlap and reject duplicate pending requests of the same kind.

Ten-second shared export deadline, persistent waiting/error status and manual retry. Clear on send failure, disconnect, room/role/authority changes and solo return; ignore late, unknown, missing and duplicate IDs.
Keep read requests out of mutating pending/command sequence and reconnect replay. Preserve an active export if resolving new role credentials fails before changing the active connection.
Use a new export-result event for UI request/kind metadata while retaining the legacy export event and unchanged BLOODFLOW-LAB-FILE-1 payload. Inventory button selects CSV per correlated reply.
Update tools and storage-recovery export controls without changing server code, world, revisions, logs, biological rules or statistical formulas.

cases: solo formats, legacy event/file schema and no state mutation
reversed shared replies with distinct formats and unchanged command sequence/revision/logs
timeout, ignored old reply and manual retry without automatic resend
duplicate, unknown and missing reply IDs
disconnect clears exports while lost-ACK mutating step replays exactly once

automated.nativeNetwork: Two actual LabClients and an unmodified child Node server use HTTP create and native WebSocket joins. Nationwide 12h, both interpretations and N 1 day x 2 repeats x 3 policies are exported by both roles without revision/sequence changes. Actual JSON is written to a Node file, read back, validated and restored with notes/result and conserved inventory; a shared restore also preserves the biology interpretation.
automated.regressions: Full suite retains startup/map failures, storage/reconnect/role/draft/compute/server restart coverage and deterministic policy, inventory conservation, compatibility, expiry and statistical checks.
automated.fixtureCorrection: Initial native test waited for A ACK but not B receiving A notes before B submitted its notes. Wait for the peer state was added to avoid an intentional revision conflict in the fixture; native test and full 183 suite then passed. No production fix was made for that fixture timing.

browser.environment: Two Chrome tabs with actual Node/WebSocket roles and unchanged application server apart from external QA-only export response hold/release/disconnect controls. Separate IndexedDB and Blob observation script are outside git.

shared.result: N 1 day x 2 repeats x 3 policies, executed by biology, 100 nodes/17 fixed regions

biologyExports: BLOODFLOW_state.json with nationwide 12h, both notes and computed result

finalConsole.scope: Bounded final error/warn queries. Baseline history was reset once after failed download waiter, so no complete baseline console claim.

browser.downloadBoundary: Actual anchor filename, MIME and Blob bytes/content were observed from application-generated Blobs. A cloud download waiter failed; native browser/OS disk completion and reopening a browser-downloaded file are NOT verified. No browser security/download setting was changed. Native Node file roundtrip is separately verified above.
browser.observationCorrection: A first final comparison mixed textContent with the saved innerText, producing whitespace-only differences. Using innerText for both matched the original full result in both tabs.

preserved: Original HTML/legacy source and example data unchanged.
Incheon 4 facilities/12 directed routes/1394 road ways and nationwide 100 nodes/17 fixed study regions unchanged.
Common simulation/biological/statistical formulas, virtual/estimated labels, equal researcher roles, four full pages and LIVE/TIMELAPSE/COMPUTE retained.
Only bloodflow/ and integrations/bloodflow-dual-lab/ changed; no server/domain/DNS/root service worker/Firebase/other PinCon paths modified.
QA control server/routes, baseline copies, Blob observer and separate DB remain outside repository.
limitations: Production health remains 404 with empty serverOrigin. Static Pages alone does not provide shared WebSocket collaboration; approved HTTPS host and persistent disk are still needed.
No actual production 503/shared-export fault was observed. No main edit, merge or manual production deployment.
No actual Galaxy, file://, airplane mode, offline single-HTML browser execution, long-duration tablet performance or hosting-disk lifecycle test in this run.
Cloud browser disk downloads could not be confirmed; generated Blob checks and native Node disk roundtrip do not substitute for actual Galaxy download/import QA.
The deadline cancels a read request; a user must retry manually, and this does not replace server persistence or recover unconfirmed note drafts.
